prompts.name: cash-register-neutral-body
prompts.prompt: Reference image is a design reference only. Generate an isolated high quality 3D-style object asset, not a poster. Match reference object's exact silhouette, proportions and elevated three-quarter camera view closely. Neutral white and light-gray materials ONLY, absolutely no blue or other color, neutral studio illumination, preserve physically convincing thickness, soft material shading and crisp highlights. True transparent background, no floor or cast shadow, no glow, no text, no letters, no grid, no extra objects. Entire object uncropped with padding. ONLY the cash-register housing/main body from the image, with its receipt roll, slanted control face and raised customer display attached. EXCLUDE the sliding drawer completely, leave a convincing dark empty rectangular drawer cavity in its base, and exclude the coin. Preserve exact pose: front faces lower-left, right side wall visible, receipt roll at upper-left on slanted face, inset rectangular screen upper-right, short pedestal display above rear-right, chunky beveled pale plastic housing. Replace colored screens with neutral medium-gray screens, no numbers or lettering, retain a few simple white button bars. This is the main body layer of a separately moving drawer assembly.
